mathematical_or_operational_scope: Necessary adjacent-column high-frequency tail recurrence at fixed n=8/P8; elimination of t,beta from two tail equations and Q yields W(h).
positive_controls: Lines 20–28 enforce affine splitting with no mixed t*beta term. Lines 65–69 require W nonzero and degree at most three.
Lines 93–105 provide a nonzero modular witness and label the gate necessary only, with endpoint/invertibility assumptions retained.

findings.issue: The export declares four variables [h0,h1,h2,hl], but W_terms preserve original parameter indices 1,2,3,4 rather than renumbering to 0,1,2,3 or exporting an explicit index map. The actual saved JSON confirms 31 terms with index set {1,2,3,4}. A conventional zero-based consumer using the advertised four-vector reads wrong coordinates or hits index 4 out of range.

The comment promises an independent fifth-Fourier-mode interpolation comparison, but the code directly recomputes the same three-term recurrence on data[L]. It tests scaling/construction consistency, not an independent interpolation criterion.
All build failures are skipped without a required successful sample count. The nonzero W witness remains separate; no full candidate is reconstructed or all factorization guards checked.
Polynomial and numeric support modules are execution dependencies outside this exact-hash batch; importing them is not authorized here and their correctness is not implied by this source read.

cost_and_scaling: Fixed-size sparse exact polynomial construction, two tail recurrences and a 3x3 determinant. Sparse products may expand with term counts; dense modular build tests have fixed n=8. No growing-n algorithm or end-to-end transform cost is supplied.
test_scope_and_limits: Designed random consistency checks: up to 48 usable samples across two primes and two roots; no lower bound on accepted samples. One modular nonzero witness. All tests were read only. Saved W metadata was inspected as inert JSON.
certificate_acceptance: W=0 is a necessary elimination condition, not sufficient consistency of the original affine equations or full factorization. Correct the coordinate encoding before independent certificate consumers rely on the JSON.
